column1: Suburb page plan - 4 tiers (Semrush AU + competitor sitemaps, 16 Oct 2026)
Rule: a suburb page goes live only with unique local content. Checklist for EVERY page:
1. Real suburb details: postcode, 3-5 nearby streets / landmarks / shopping centre, typical local housing (units, townhouses, older homes) - from your own knowledge of the jobs.
2. At least 2 real jobs done in that suburb (fault, brand, fix, time to complete) + photo with suburb in the caption / alt text; add a real review from a customer in that suburb when available.
3. Own FAQ (3-5 questions that differ per suburb: travel time, same-day availability, call-out fee, common brands in that area), embedded map, phone number and booking form above the fold.
4. Internal links: to the 3 most relevant service pages, 2 brand pages, /service-areas/ and 2 neighbouring suburb pages. Link to it from /service-areas/ and the homepage area section.
5. Never copy a page and only replace the suburb name. After 8 weeks, merge or noindex any suburb page that has zero impressions in Search Console.
